name: windows-computer-use
description: Local Windows desktop automation tools for Codex. Provides observe/act loops, fast screenshots, OCR, UI Automation controls, hwnd window control, app switching, batched mouse and keyboard actions, scroll, drag, and waits through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Control Windows mouse and keyboard locally
interface.longDescription: Windows Computer Use exposes a small local MCP server for observe/act_and_observe loops, fast screenshots, OCR-assisted click_text/find_text/wait_for_text, Windows UI Automation controls, hwnd-based window control, app switching, mouse movement, clicks, scroll, drag, keyboard input, hotkeys, batched actions, and waits. It is a community/local approximation of desktop computer use for Windows, not the official OpenAI Computer Use plugin.
defaultPrompt: Take a screenshot and tell me what is visible.
Click this Windows app button for me.
Type this into the focused Windows app.
